cohort: 100 pregnant patients with post-dated pregnancies (EDD + 2 days or more) were included in the study.
finding: The Foley catheter group had a significantly higher mean Apgar score at 1 minute and a significantly lower incidence of uterine tachysystole compared to the dinoprostone group.
mod_finding: No significant difference was observed in the mode of delivery between the Foley catheter and dinoprostone gel induction groups (p=0.73), though both methods generally increased spontaneous vaginal delivery rates and reduced caesarean deliveries.
